GOTRUE_API_HOST.name: GOTRUE_API_HOST
GOTRUE_API_HOST.description: Bind address for the GoTrue (Supabase Auth) API server. 0.0.0.0 binds all interfaces so Railway's proxy can reach it.

GOTRUE_API_PORT.name: GOTRUE_API_PORT
GOTRUE_API_PORT.description: Listen port for GoTrue API. Set to Railway-injected ${{PORT}} so health checks and Kong proxy can reach it.

GOTRUE_DB_DATABASE_URL.name: GOTRUE_DB_DATABASE_URL
GOTRUE_DB_DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string for GoTrue. Uses private networking and references postgres service vars.

DATABASE_URL.name: DATABASE_URL
DATABASE_URL.description: Raw PostgreSQL connection string (without search_path). Available for migrations and tooling.

POSTGRES_HOST.name: POSTGRES_HOST
POSTGRES_HOST.description: Postgres private domain — used by the startCommand wait-for-db loop.

POSTGRES_PORT.name: POSTGRES_PORT
POSTGRES_PORT.description: Postgres TCP port — used by the startCommand wait-for-db loop.

JWT_SECRET.name: JWT_SECRET
JWT_SECRET.description: JWT secret used to sign API tokens. Default is the Supabase demo secret — change this and regenerate ANON_KEY/SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for production.

GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET.name: GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET
GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET.description: GoTrue-specific JWT secret. Mirrors JWT_SECRET within the same service.

GOTRUE_JWT_EXP.name: GOTRUE_JWT_EXP
GOTRUE_JWT_EXP.description: JWT expiration time in seconds (3600 = 1 hour).

API_EXTERNAL_URL.name: API_EXTERNAL_URL
API_EXTERNAL_URL.description: External-facing API URL. Points to the Kong gateway's public domain so OAuth redirects work correctly.

GOTRUE_SITE_URL.name: GOTRUE_SITE_URL
GOTRUE_SITE_URL.description: Site URL for auth redirect flows. Points to the Kong gateway public domain.

GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST.name: GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST
GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of additional allowed redirect URIs for OAuth flows. Leave empty to allow only the site URL.

GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED.name: GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED
GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED.description: Enable external email provider support. Set to false to disable email auth.

GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM.name: GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM
GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM.description: Auto-confirm user emails on signup (development mode). Set to false in production to require email verification.

GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST.name: GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST
GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server host for sending auth emails. Leave empty to disable email sending (emails will not be sent). Example: smtp.gmail.com

GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT.name: GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT
GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT.description: SMTP server port. Must be numeric (GoTrue requires an integer). Common: 587 (TLS), 465 (SSL), 25 (unencrypted). Ignored when GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST is empty.

ANON_KEY.name: ANON_KEY
ANON_KEY.description: Public client API key — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET with role=anon. Pre-computed for default JWT_SECRET; regenerate if you change JWT_SECRET.

SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.name: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Server-side key with full database access — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET with role=service_role. Pre-computed for default JWT_SECRET; regenerate if you change JWT_SECRET.

DASHBOARD_USERNAME.name: DASHBOARD_USERNAME
DASHBOARD_USERNAME.description: Username for admin dashboard access (if Studio were included).

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD
DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password for admin dashboard access. Auto-generated.
